other_conditions: Priority given to households below the poverty line or belonging to marginalized communities
Women-headed households and women/girl children are given priority
Small and marginal farmers are eligible
Landless labourers, migrant workers, and people with disabilities may be covered depending on the state or district
Village panchayats with a high percentage of households lacking basic amenities are prioritized
Eligibility criteria may vary by state or district
benefits_summary: Provides basic amenities such as electricity, water supply, and sanitation to rural households, improving overall village development
